l-e-m2-b01-01.title: Ọ zuru ezu naanị ịgbakwunye -er na nkọwa?
l-e-m2-b01-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "the comparative of an adjective is made by adding -er" bụ eziokwu oge ọ bụla, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: A na-eme ụdị atụnyere nke nkọwa ọ bụla site n'ịgbakwunye -er. Chọta ụzọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ihe atụ nwere -er agbakwunyere. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ihe atụ nwere -er agbakwunyere. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ihe atụ nwere -er agbakwunyere. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-01.s.s1.explain: good na-aghọ better, ọ bụghị gooder. Okwu ụfọdụ anaghị agbaso iwu.
l-e-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: Ụdị atụnyere nke good bụ better, ọ bụghị gooder, ya mere nkwupụta na ị na-agbakwunye -er adịghị mma.
l-e-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Okwu ụfọdụ, dị ka better, na-agbanwe ụdị ha n'enweghị -er, ya mere a naghị agbakwunye -er na okwu niile.

l-e-m2-b01-02.title: Ngwaa na-abịa mgbe to mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "a verb after a verb is always to + base verb" bụ eziokwu oge ọ bụla, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe ngwaa ọzọ na-abịa ozugbo mgbe ngwaa, a na-ede ya mgbe niile dị ka to + ngwaa ntọala. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: to leave na-abịa mgbe need. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-02.s.s1.r.b: to swim na-abịa mgbe want. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-02.s.s1.r.d: to win na-abịa mgbe hope. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-02.s.s1.explain: Mgbe enjoy ị na-eji -ing, ọ bụghị to. Ya mere ahịrị okwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe enjoys na-abịa playing, ọ bụghị to play, ya mere nkwupụta na ị na-eji to mgbe niile adịghị mma.
l-e-m2-b01-02.s.s2.model.1: Enjoy bụ ngwaa na-ewere -ing, ya mere ngwaa mgbe ngwaa abụghị to + ngwaa ntọala mgbe niile.

l-e-m2-b01-03.title: Enwere ike ịgbanwe ahịrị okwu ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ passive?
l-e-m2-b01-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "any sentence can be changed into the passive" bụ eziokwu oge ọ bụla, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b01-03.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrị okwu ọ bụla na-aghọ ahịrị okwu passive ma ọ bụrụ na ị bugharịa ihe ahụ n'isiokwu. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị okwu enweghị ike ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ passive.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s1.r.a: Akwụkwọ ozi bụ ihe ahụ, ya mere enwere ike ịgbanwe ya.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s1.r.b: Cats bụ ihe ahụ, ya mere enwere ike ịgbanwe ya.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s1.r.c: The window bụ ihe ahụ, ya mere enwere ike ịgbanwe ya. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s1.explain: Sleep bụ ngwaa na-enweghị ihe, ya mere ọ dịghị ihe a ga-ebugara n'isiokwu. Ya mere enweghị ike ime ya passive.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s2.model.0: The baby sleeps enweghị ihe, ya mere enweghị ike ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ passive, ma nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-m2-b01-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe sleep ọ dịghị ihe na-anata omume ahụ, ya mere ọ bụghị ahịrị okwu ọ bụla enwere ike ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ passive.

l-e-m2-b01-04.title: Present perfect nwere for ma ọ bụ since mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b01-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "a present perfect sentence must have an expression of time length" bụ eziokwu oge ọ bụla, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrị okwu present perfect (have/has + past participle) ga-agụnyerị okwu ogologo oge dị ka for ma ọ bụ since. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b01-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere since noon. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ nwere since last night. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere for two years. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-04.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ị na-ekwu banyere ihe agwụla ugbu a, dị ka n'have just finished, ị na-eji present perfect ọbụna n'enweghị for ma ọ bụ since.
l-e-m2-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: have just finished enweghị for ma ọ bụ since ma ọ ka bụ present perfect, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-m2-b01-04.s.s2.model.1: Present perfect maka ihe agwụla ugbu a enweghị okwu ogologo oge, ya mere ikwu na ọ ga-adị mgbe niile adịghị mma.

l-e-m2-b01-05.topic: Iji ọnọdụ chọta ihe okwu pụtara
l-e-m2-b01-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "bank means a place for money in any text" bụ eziokwu oge ọ bụla, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: Bank pụtara "ebe maka ego" n'ederede ọ bụla. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị okwu ebe bank anaghị apụta ebe maka ego.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s1.r.b: E nwere oge mmeghe, ya mere ọ pụtara ebe maka ego. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s1.r.c: E weere mgbazinye ego, ya mere ọ pụtara ebe maka ego. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s1.r.d: E nwere okwu gbasara ego, ya mere ọ pụtara ebe maka ego. Ihe atụ a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s1.explain: Bank dị n'river bank pụtara akụkụ osimiri. Otu okwu ahụ nwere ihe ọ pụtara dị iche dabere n'okwu ndị gbara ya gburugburu.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: N'river bank, bank pụtara akụkụ osimiri, ya mere bank abụghị ebe maka ego mgbe niile.
l-e-m2-b01-05.s.s2.model.1: Mmadụ nọdụrụ n'akụkụ osimiri, ya mere bank pụtara akụkụ osimiri, ma nkwupụta na ọ pụtara ebe maka ego n'ederede ọ bụla adịghị mma.

l-e-m2-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na okwu na-ejedebe na -er, ọ bụ comparative mgbe niile. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu na-ejedebe na -er mana ọ bụghị comparative?
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ comparative e mere site n'ịgbakwunye -er na tall. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ comparative e mere site n'ịgbakwunye -er na cold. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ comparative e mere site n'ịgbakwunye -er na fast. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s1.explain: teacher bụ aha maka onye na-akụzi. Ụfọdụ okwu na-ejedebe na -er mana ha abụghị comparatives.
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s2.model.0: teacher na-ejedebe na -er mana ọ bụ aha maka onye na-akụzi, ya mere nkwupụta na okwu ọ bụla na-ejedebe na -er bụ comparative ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b02-01.s.s2.model.1: teacher, nke enweghị ihe ntụnyere pụtara, na-ejedebekwa na -er, ya mere ị pụghị ikwu na okwu bụ comparative site na mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ ya naanị.

l-e-m2-b02-02.title: Udi isi nke ngwaa ọ̀ na-abịa mgbe to mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ozugbo mgbe to n'ahịrịokwu, udi isi nke ngwaa na-abịa mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: leave na-abịa mgbe to. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-02.s.s1.r.c: stay na-abịa mgbe to. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-02.s.s1.r.d: see na-abịa mgbe to. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m2-b02-03.title: A na-eji passive voice naanị maka oge gara aga?
l-e-m2-b02-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na a na-eji passive voice naanị maka ihe dị n'oge gara aga ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ naghị adị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b02-03.material: Echiche: A na-eji passive naanị mgbe a na-ekwu ihe mere n’oge gara aga. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere ya.
l-e-m2-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: were broken dị na past; ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche.
l-e-m2-b02-03.s.s1.r.b: was sent dị na past; ihe atụ kwekọrọ.
l-e-m2-b02-03.s.s1.r.d: was made dị na past; ihe atụ kwekọrọ.
l-e-m2-b02-03.s.s1.explain: A na-ekwu eziokwu dị ugbu a na passive kwa, dịka is spoken. A naghị eji passive naanị maka past, kamakwa present na future.
l-e-m2-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: English is spoken bụ passive gbasara ugbu a; ya mere echiche na ọ bụ naanị past ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: is spoken na-ekwu eziokwu ka dị ugbu a; ya mere a pụghị ikwu na passive bụ past naanị.

l-e-m2-b02-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ọnọdụ ebe okwu na ọdịdị adịghị ekwekọ.
l-e-m2-b02-05.s.s1.r.a: Okwu na ihu kwekọrọ; ihe atụ dabara n’echiche.
l-e-m2-b02-05.s.s1.r.c: Okwu na omume kwekọrọ; ihe atụ dabara.
l-e-m2-b02-05.s.s1.r.d: Okwu na ọdịdị kwekọrọ; ihe atụ dabara.
l-e-m2-b02-05.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ sị na ọ dị mma mgbe ihu ya gbawara agbawa, okwu na mmetụta ya dị iche. Omume bụkwa ihe ngosi n’ederede.
l-e-m2-b02-05.s.s2.model.0: Onye ahụ sịrị It’s fine ma na-agbarụ ihu; ya mere okwu na mmetụta adịghị otu, okwu anaghị egosi ezi mmetụta mgbe niile.

l-e-m2-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: Very hot dị mma; ihe atụ dabara.

l-e-m2-b03-02.title: A na-eji to mgbe niile mgbe ngwaa ịrịọ mmadụ ime ihe gasịrị?
l-e-m2-b03-02.topic: Ụdị Okwu Mgbe Ngwaa Arịrịọ Gasịrị
l-e-m2-b03-02.goal: Lelee ma ngwaa pụtara ịrịọ mmadụ ime ihe na-enwe to mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-m2-b03-02.material: Echiche: Mgbe ngwaa pụtara ime ka mmadụ mee ihe gasịrị, a na-eji person + to + base verb mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide.
l-e-m2-b03-02.s.s1.r.a: To wait na-eso you; ihe atụ dabara.
l-e-m2-b03-02.s.s1.r.c: To wait na-eso guide; ihe atụ dabara.
l-e-m2-b03-02.s.s1.r.d: To stop na-eso us; ihe atụ dabara.
l-e-m2-b03-02.s.s1.explain: Mgbe make + person gasịrị, jiri ngwaa nkịtị n’enweghị to: made us run.
l-e-m2-b03-02.s.s2.model.0: Made us run enweghị to; ya mere echiche na to na-eso ngwaa na-eme ka mmadụ mee ihe mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b03-02.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe make gasịrị, ngwaa nkịtị na-esochi onye ahụ ozugbo; ya mere ọ bụghị ngwaa ime ka mmadụ mee ihe niile na-eji to.

l-e-m2-b03-03.title: be + past participle ọ na-abụ passive mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b03-03.goal: Tụlee ma be verb + past participle bụ passive mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-m2-b03-03.material: Echiche: Ọ bụrụ na past participle na-eso be verb, ahịrịokwu ahụ bụ passive mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide ya.
l-e-m2-b03-03.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ passive gbasara ime ka ọnụ ụlọ dị ọcha. Ọ dabara n’echiche.
l-e-m2-b03-03.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ passive gbasara ihe ndị ọbịa riri.
l-e-m2-b03-03.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ passive gbasara ide akwụkwọ ozi.
l-e-m2-b03-03.s.s1.explain: Excited bụ adjective na-akọ mmetụta nke obi ụtọ. Ọ bụghị ihe onye ọzọ mere mmadụ.
l-e-m2-b03-03.s.s2.model.0: Excited bụ adjective na-akọ mmetụta; n’agbanyeghị ọdịdị be + past participle, ọ bụghị passive.
l-e-m2-b03-03.s.s2.model.1: I am excited about the trip ekwughị na mmadụ mere m obi ụtọ; ya mere ọ bụghị passive n’agbanyeghị otu ọdịdị.

l-e-m2-b03-04.title: Present perfect ọ na-ekwu naanị ihe ndị mechara?
l-e-m2-b03-04.goal: Tụlee ma present perfect na-ekwu naanị ihe ka mechara, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-m2-b03-04.material: Echiche: Present perfect (have + past participle) na-ekwu naanị ihe mechara. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere ya.
l-e-m2-b03-04.s.s1.r.a: Nri ehihie ka mechara. Ọ dabara n’echiche.
l-e-m2-b03-04.s.s1.r.d: Mmadụ apụlarị, ya mere o mechara.
l-e-m2-b03-04.s.s1.explain: Have lived here for ten years pụtara ibi ebe a site n’afọ 10 gara aga ruo ugbu a; ọ ka na-aga n’ihu.
l-e-m2-b03-04.s.s2.model.0: Have lived here for ten years ka na-aga n’ihu ugbu a; ya mere present perfect anaghị ekwu naanị ihe mechara.
l-e-m2-b03-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-ekwu ihe dịgidere afọ 10 ma ka na-aga n’ihu; present perfect abụghị maka ihe mechara naanị.

l-e-m2-b03-05.title: Akụkọ ọjọọ ọ na-abịa mgbe but gasịrị mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b03-05.goal: Tụlee ma ihe ọjọọ na-abịa mgbe but gasịrị mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-m2-b03-05.material: Echiche: Ọ bụrụ na ahịrịokwu nwere but, ihe ọjọọ na-eso ya mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu ebe ozi ọma na-eso but.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu ebe ozi ọma na-abịa mgbe but gasịrị.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.r.b: Ịjụ oyi bụ ozi ọjọọ; kwekọrọ n’echiche.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.r.c: Enweghị ụgbọ ala bụ ozi ọjọọ.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.r.d: Imechi ụlọ ahịa bụ ozi ọjọọ.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.explain: But na-ejikọta ihe megidere nke bu ya ụzọ. Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ mbụ siri ike, ihe ọma nwere ike iso.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s2.model.0: Fun bụ ihe ọma ma ọ na-eso but; ya mere echiche na ihe na-eso ya bụ ihe ọjọọ mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s2.model.1: Fun na-eso njem siri ike; but na-ejikọta echiche ndị megidere, ọ naghị eduga n’ozi ọjọọ mgbe niile.

l-e-m2-b04-01.title: "The" dị n'ihu ụdị kacha elu mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b04-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "there is always the before a superlative" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b04-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrị okwu nwere ụdị kacha elu dị ka best, -est, ma ọ bụ most nwere the mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ the biggest, ya mere the dị. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ the coldest, ya mere the dị. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ the best, ya mere the dị. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.explain: Enwere ike iji ụdị kacha elu fastest nke okwu na-akọwa ngwaa fast n'enweghị the. Ị ghaghị iji the mgbe niile na ụdị kacha elu.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s2.model.0: N'"Our team ran fastest.", enweghị the tupu ụdị kacha elu fastest, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s2.model.1: Enwere ike iji ụdị kacha elu nke okwu na-akọwa ngwaa n'enweghị the, ya mere nkwupụta na the dị mgbe niile adịghị mma.

l-e-m2-b05-01.title: To + verb na -ing ọ̀ pụtara otu ihe mgbe niile?
l-e-m2-b05-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na to + verb na verb + -ing nwere ike ịgbanwe nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m2-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: After the same verb, using to + base form or using -ing always gives the same meaning. Chọta ụzọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-m2-b01-07.goal: Chọpụta ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji chọta iwu na-ekewa ojiji nke to n'ahịrị okwu, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.

l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s1.o.a: Ma verb ma ọ bụ ebe na-abịa mgbe to
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s1.r.b: I want to eat enweghị s, ma verb na-abịa mgbe to.
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s1.o.c: Ma isiokwu bụ I ma ọ bụ ọ bụghị
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: I want na I go nọ n'otu dị iche.
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ okwu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na otú a na-eji to.
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s1.explain: Mgbe verb dị ka eat ma ọ bụ sleep na-abịa mgbe to, ọ bụ to-infinitive, ma mgbe ebe dị ka school ma ọ bụ park na-abịa mgbe to, ọ bụ to na-egosi ntụzi.
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: Nke a bụ iwu n'ihi na ihe dị iche bụ ma verb dị ka eat ma ọ bụ sleep na-abịa mgbe to ma ọ bụ ebe dị ka school ma ọ bụ park.
l-e-m2-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: Verb mgbe to pụtara to-infinitive ma ebe pụtara ntụzi, ya mere ị na-ekewa site n'okwu mgbe to.

l-e-m2-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo anaghị agwa gị otú e si wuo ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m2-b01-08.s.s1.explain: The cook na-eme omume ma The soup na-anata omume. Ma isiokwu na-eme ma ọ bụ na-anata omume na-ekewa active na passive.

l-e-m2-b07-01.title: Ozi achọrọ iji kpebie ụdị mgbe enjoy
l-e-m2-b07-01.goal: Kpebie ụkpụrụ (ozi) nke achọrọ n'ezie iji chọta ụdị verb ziri ezi mgbe enjoy, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m2-b07-01.material: Ahịrịokwu ebe efu: She enjoys ____ (draw) comics. drawing na to draw bụ nhọrọ. Chọta ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie nke ziri ezi.
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ụdị verb na-esote?
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ noun na-esote enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụdị.
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.o.b: Na verb tupu ya bụ enjoys
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.o.c: Na isiokwu She bụ otu onye
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ nke isiokwu dị mkpa maka be verb ma ọ bụ -s. Ọ nweghị ike ikpebi ụdị.
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.o.d: Na ahịrịokwu dị n'oge ugbu a
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụlagodi na tense bụ otu, ụdị na-esote dị iche site na verb gaa na verb.
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s1.explain: -ing na-abịa mgbe enjoy. Dị ka to na-abịa mgbe want, verb tupu ya na-ekpebi ụdị na-esote.
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s2.model.0: Verb tupu ya bụ enjoy, ya mere drawing ziri ezi. Ọbụlagodi na isiokwu ma ọ bụ tense bụ otu, to na-abịa mgbe want, ya mere nhọrọ ndị ọzọ ezughị ezu.
l-e-m2-b07-01.s.s2.model.1: enjoy bụ verb nke -ing na-eso, ya mere ịmara verb ahụ achọrọ n'ezie. Ịmara naanị na isiokwu bụ otu enweghị ike ịkewa drawing na to draw.

l-e-m2-b01-11.title: Iwu maka ime consonant okpukpu abụọ n'comparatives
l-e-m2-b01-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iwu maka ime consonant ikpeazụ okpukpu abụọ mgbe a na-agbakwunye -er, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma lelee iwu ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b01-11.material: big → bigger, hot → hotter, thin → thinner. cold → colder, long → longer, fast → faster. Ahịrị elu na ahịrị ala na-agbakwunye -er n'ụzọ dị iche.
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.o.a: Mee consonant okpukpu abụọ mgbe niile tupu -er
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: cold → colder anaghị eme consonant okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-akwụsị na t ma ọ bụ g, mee consonant okpukpu abụọ
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.r.b: thin na-akwụsị na n, ma ọ ka na-eme ya okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na okwu na-akwụsị na otu vowel + otu consonant, mee consonant okpukpu abụọ
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.o.d: Naanị okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede atọ na-eme consonant okpukpu abụọ
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: thin nwere mkpụrụedemede anọ, ma ọ ka na-eme ya okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s1.explain: big, hot, na thin na-akwụsị na otu vowel nke consonant na-esote. cold, long, na fast na-akwụsị na consonants abụọ, ya mere ị na-agbakwunye -er naanị.
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: big, hot, na thin na-akwụsị na otu vowel nke consonant na-esote, ya mere ha na-eme consonant okpukpu abụọ, ma cold nwere consonants abụọ, ya mere ọ naghị eme okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-m2-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Okwu ọhụrụ fat na-akwụsị na vowel a na consonant t, ya mere site n'iwu ọ na-abụ fatter. Iwu a kwekọrọ n'ihe atụ isii niile, ya mere enwere ike ịtụkwasị ya obi.

l-e-m2-b01-12.title: Gịnị ka to + verb ụdị isi pụtara?
l-e-m2-b01-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ihe to + verb ụdị isi na-egosi, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma lelee iwu ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b01-12.material: I use a pen to write. / We went out to play. / A kid saves money to buy a bike. Chọta ihe to + verb ụdị isi na-ekekọrịta n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile.
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ iwu ziri ezi site n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ?
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.o.a: A na-ede ebumnuche dị ka for + verb ụdị isi
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.r.a: for write adịghị mma. Tupu verb ị na-eji to.
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.o.b: A na-ede ebumnuche site n'ịgbakwunye -ing n'verb
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: use a pen writing anaghị egosi ebumnuche.
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.o.c: to + verb ụdị isi na-egosi ebumnuche, pụtara "iji"
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.o.d: Noun na-abịa mgbe to mgbe niile
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: write, play, na buy bụ verbs, ọ bụghị nouns.
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s1.explain: To tupu write, play, na buy pụtara "iji." Students study hard to pass na-agbaso otu iwu ahụ.
l-e-m2-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: Ebumnuche nke iji pen bụ ide, ma ebumnuche nke ichekwa ego bụ ịzụ, ya mere to + verb ụdị isi na-ekwu ebumnuche.

l-e-m2-b01-13.title: Kedu otú a na-ekpebi be verb n'passive?
l-e-m2-b01-13.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iwu na-ekpebi tense nke be verb n'passive, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma lelee iwu ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ iwu ziri ezi site n'ụzọ atọ ahụ?
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.o.a: Be verb na-ebu tense, ma past participle na-esote ya
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.r.b: N'ahịrịokwu oge ugbu a, a jiri is, ọ bụghị was.
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: A na-eji past participle dị ka cleaned.
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.o.d: Hichapụ object ma hapụ verb naanị
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: the hall na-esite n'object gaa n'isiokwu.
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s1.explain: Oge ugbu a bụ is cleaned, oge gara aga bụ was cleaned, ma ọdịnihu bụ will be cleaned. cleaned na-anọgide otu ma be verb na-ebu tense.
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile cleaned na-anọgide otu ma naanị is, was, na will be na-agbanwe, ya mere be verb na-ebu tense.
l-e-m2-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ahịrịokwu mbụ dị n'oge ugbu a, ọ bụ is, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị n'oge gara aga, ọ bụ was, ya mere ahịrịokwu ọhụrụ Workers painted the hall na-abụkwa The hall was painted.

l-e-m2-b01-14.title: Kedu otú ị na-ekewa have na has?
l-e-m2-b01-14.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iwu maka ịhọrọ have ma ọ bụ has n'present perfect, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma lelee iwu ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b01-14.material: I have eaten. / You have eaten. / The dog has eaten. / The dogs have eaten. / It has rained. Chọta iwu na-ekewa have na has n'ahịrịokwu ise ndị a.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ iwu ziri ezi ị chọtara?
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụrụ na isiokwu bụ onye 3rd otu, has; ma ọ bụghị, have
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụrụ na ahịrịokwu dị mkpụmkpụ, has
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo nke ahịrịokwu anaghị ekpebi have ma ọ bụ has.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na isiokwu bụ otu, mgbe niile has
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: I bụkwa otu, ma ọ na-eji have.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na isiokwu bụ mmadụ, have; ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ anụmanụ, has
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: The dogs bụ anụmanụ, ma ọ na-eji have.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Onye 3rd otu dị ka The dog na It na-ewere has, ma I, You, na The dogs na-ewere have.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: Naanị onye 3rd otu dị ka The dog na It na-ewere has, ebe I, You, na The dogs na-ewere have, ya mere nke a bụ iwu.

l-e-m2-b01-15.topic: Ichepụta ihe ọ pụtara site na prefixes
l-e-m2-b01-15.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ihe ọ pụtara mgbe a gbakwunyere un- n'ihu okwu, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma lelee iwu ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b01-15.material: unhappy = not happy / unfair = not fair / unkind = not kind. Jiri otu iwu ahụ chee ihe okwu ọhụrụ unclear pụtara.
l-e-m2-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ iwu ziri ezi site n'ihe atụ atọ ahụ?
l-e-m2-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: un- na-eme okwu ka ọ bụrụ noun
l-e-m2-b01-15.s.s1.explain: un- pụtara not, ya mere unclear pụtara "not clear."
l-e-m2-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: E tinyere not n'ihu okwu atọ ahụ niile, ya mere un- na-eme nke megidere, ma unclear pụtara not clear.
l-e-m2-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: Oge ọ bụla a gbakwunyere un- n'happy, fair, ma ọ bụ kind, a na-ajụ ihe ọma ahụ pụtara, ya mere unclear pụtakwara not clear.

l-e-m2-b02-11.title: Irregular verbs na-agbanwe i-a-u
l-e-m2-b02-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ mgbanwe irregular verbs, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b02-11.material: drink-drank-drunk / begin-began-begun / swim-swam-swum. Tulee base, past na past participle.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu ị hụrụ n’ihe atụ atọ ahụ?
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: Tinye -ed na past na past participle.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Past participle bụ otu na base form.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: Past na past participle nwere otu ụdị.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Ụdaume dị n’etiti na-agbanwe i → a → u.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Ụdaume na-agbanwe i → a → u. Ngwaa ring ọhụrụ na-agbaso iwu: ring-rang-rung.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: drink, begin, swim niile gbanwere ụdaume i, a, u; nke a bụ iwu na-akọwa atọ ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Iwu a nyere ring rang na rung, ha bụkwa eziokwu; ya mere a pụrụ ịtụkwasị iwu ahụ obi.

l-e-m2-b02-12.title: Gịnị na-abịa n’etiti as na as?
l-e-m2-b02-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ as ~ as, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya.
l-e-m2-b02-12.material: My dog is as big as yours. The bus is as fast as the train. This song is as beautiful as that one. Lee adjective dị n’etiti as abụọ.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu ị hụrụ n’ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ?
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Jiri adjective n’ụdị mbụ ya n’etiti as abụọ.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: As nke abụọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ than.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dịghị ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ nwere than.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.explain: as ~ as pụtara “dị ka ...”; n’etiti ha jiri ụdị mbụ, dịka big ma ọ bụ fast.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: N’ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ, ụdị mbụ big, fast, beautiful dị n’etiti as abụọ; ya mere etinyela -er.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu ọhụrụ The box is as heavier as the bag adịghị mma n’ihi -er; as heavy as ziri ezi, iwu ahụ kwadoro.

l-e-m2-b02-13.title: Usoro okwu mgbe want, ask, tell gasịrị
l-e-m2-b02-13.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ahịrịokwu “ịrịọ mmadụ ka o mee ihe,” kwuo iwu usoro okwu ma nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b02-13.material: I want my friend to come. We asked the guide to wait. The coach told the team to run. Lelee usoro okwu.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s1.o.a: Dee n’usoro ngwaa + to + mmadụ + ngwaa nkịtị.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dịghị ahịrịokwu nke e dere dịka want to my friend come.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s1.o.b: Jiri naanị ngwaa + mmadụ + ngwaa nkịtị.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s1.r.b: A na-enwe to mgbe niile mgbe onye ahụ gasịrị.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s1.o.c: Dee n’usoro ngwaa + mmadụ + to + ngwaa nkịtị.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Mgbe want, ask, tell gasịrị, tinye onye a na-agwa, mesịa to + ngwaa nkịtị.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: N’ahịrịokwu atọ, mmadụ na-eso ngwaa ozugbo, mesịa to + ngwaa; nke a bụ iwu.
l-e-m2-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu ọhụrụ The teacher wants us to sit bụ want + us + to sit; ya mere iwu ahụ na-arụ ọrụ.

l-e-m2-b02-14.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ihe atụ ịhọrọ is na are na passive, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu ị hụrụ n’ahịrịokwu anọ ahụ?
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.o.a: Ngwaa be na-ekwekọ na ọnụọgụ nke isiokwu (onye na-anata)
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Gbakwunye -s na past participle iji gosi ọnụọgụ
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.r.b: Cleaned na-anọgide otu ma isiokwu bụ otu ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ.
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: Ngwaa be na-ekwekọ na ọnụọgụ nke onye na-eme
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.r.c: Onye na-eme anaghị apụta n'ahịrị okwu ahụ.
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: A jiri Are na isiokwu ọtụtụ.
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Room na-ewere is ma rooms na-ewere are. N'passive kwa, ngwaa be na-eso ọnụọgụ nke isiokwu.
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ is maka room na are maka rooms ebe cleaned na-anọgide otu, ya mere ngwaa be na-eso ọnụọgụ nke isiokwu.
l-e-m2-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Isiokwu otu na-ewere is ma isiokwu ọtụtụ na-ewere are, ya mere ahịrị okwu ọhụrụ The doors are locked nwekwara dabara n'iwu ahụ.

l-e-m2-b02-15.title: Kedu ụdị mmekọrịta so na-eme?
l-e-m2-b02-15.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ikpe nke mmekọrịta onye na-ejikọta so na-ejikọta, kwuo iwu ị chọtara, ma lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe so na-abịa nsonaazụ nke ihe bịara na mbụ
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: Mgbe so na-abịa ihe megidere ihe bịara na mbụ
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.r.b: Stayed inside bụ nsonaazụ nke mmiri ozuzo, ọ bụghị mmegide.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.c: Tupu so na-abịa nsonaazụ, ma mgbe ya na-abịa ihe kpatara
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: Ihe kpatara mmiri ozuzo dị tupu so.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.r.d: So na-ejikọta ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ kama usoro.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.explain: It rained so they stayed inside, and they were tired so they went to bed early. Tupu so bụ ihe kpatara, ma mgbe ya bụ nsonaazụ.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrị okwu atọ niile, akụkụ tupu so bụ ihe kpatara ma akụkụ mgbe ya bụ nsonaazụ ya, ya mere so na-eduga n'nsonaazụ.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-agụ dị ka ịnọ n'ime n'ihi mmiri ozuzo, ya mere ihe na-abịa mgbe so bụ nsonaazụ nke ihe bịara na mbụ.

l-e-m2-b03-11.title: Iwu maka “the more..., the more...”
l-e-m2-b03-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ usoro comparative “the more..., the more...”, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b03-11.s.s1.o.a: Akụkụ abụọ ahụ niile malitere na the + comparative
l-e-m2-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: Better, wiser, na higher bụ comparatives.

l-e-m2-b03-12.title: Ụkpụrụ maka how to, where to, na what to
l-e-m2-b03-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọmụmaatụ nke ụkpụrụ na to + base verb na-abịa mgbe okwu ajụjụ, kwuo ụkpụrụ ahụ, ma lelee ya site n'ihe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b03-12.material: I know how to swim. Do you know where to go? We don't know what to buy. Lelee ụdị nke na-abịa mgbe okwu ajụjụ n'ahịrịokwu atọ a.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe okwu ajụjụ, anyị na-eji verb + -ing
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: Swim, go, na buy abụghị ụdị -ing.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Okwu ajụjụ + to + base verb pụtara "ihe/otu esi/ebe... ime"
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.c: A hapụrụ to nke dị mgbe okwu ajụjụ
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile nwere to.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: Okwu ajụjụ + to na-apụta ebumnuche mgbe niile
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: How to swim bụ ụzọ e si eme ihe, ọ bụghị ebumnuche.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.explain: How to swim pụtara ụzọ e si egwu mmiri, where to go pụtara ebe ị ga-aga, ma what to buy pụtara ihe ị ga-azụ.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile nwere to + base verb mgbe okwu ajụjụ, ma ha na-ekwu maka ụzọ, ebe, ma ọ bụ ihe, ya mere a pụrụ ịhụ ụkpụrụ ahụ.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrịokwu ọhụrụ ahụ She knows when to leave, when to leave pụtara mgbe o kwesịrị ịhapụ, ya mere ụkpụrụ ahụ ziri ezi.

l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.o.b: Usoro ya bụ be + modal verb + past participle

l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: Usoro ya bụ modal verb + be + past participle

l-e-m2-b04-12.s.s1.prompt: We are tired of ___ for the bus. Kedu nke ziri ezi?

l-e-m2-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ niile, ngwaa na-eso preposition bụ -ing; ya mere waiting ziri ezi mgbe of gasịrị.

l-e-m2-b04-13.title: Iwu ime ajụjụ passive voice
l-e-m2-b04-13.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ ịgbanwe passive ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya.
l-e-m2-b04-13.material: The cake was baked. → Was the cake baked? Rooms are cleaned. → Are rooms cleaned? The song is sung. → Is the song sung? Chọta iwu ma tinye n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.prompt: The windows were opened. Kedu ajụjụ ziri ezi?
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: Ajụjụ passive na-ebuga be n’ihu, ọ bụghị did.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: Windows bụ plural; ya mere were, ọ bụghị was.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Bugharịa be n’ihu isiokwu, hapụ past participle otu. Ọ bụ Were the windows opened?
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ be na-aga n’ihu isiokwu, past participle adịghị agbanwe; ya mere Were the windows opened?
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Windows bụ plural, ahịrịokwu dịkwa past; were na-abịa mbụ: Were the windows opened?

l-e-m2-b04-14.title: Iwu iji for na since
l-e-m2-b04-14.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ihe atụ for na since na present perfect, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya.
l-e-m2-b04-14.material: We have lived here for three years. We have waited since 8 o’clock. We have studied for two hours. We have played since Monday. Tinye iwu n’ahịrịokwu ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.b: Na present perfect, mmalite bụ since, ọ bụghị from.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.c: For na-ewere ogologo oge, ọ bụghị oge kpọmkwem dịka last summer.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.explain: Jiri for tupu ogologo oge (afọ atọ), since tupu oge ihe malitere (8, Monday).
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ for bu ogologo oge, since bu oge mmalite; ya mere jiri since tupu last summer.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.1: Last summer bụ oge mmalite; since ziri ezi. For bụ naanị maka ogologo oge.

l-e-m2-b04-15.title: Iwu past participle nke eaten na seen
l-e-m2-b04-15.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ihe atụ ịchọta past participle nke drive, kwuo iwu ma nwalee ya.
l-e-m2-b04-15.material: eat → eaten, see → seen, take → taken, write → written. Have na-abịa n’ihu past participle ndị a. Jiri iwu ahụ chọpụta past participle drive.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.prompt: I have ___ a bus before. Kedu nke ziri ezi?
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ regular, e tinyere -ed. Ihe atụ na-agwụ na -n.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.r.b: Drove bụ past form; past participle ihe atụ na-agwụ na -n.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Past participles ihe atụ niile na-agwụ na -n ma ọ bụ -en. Drive bụ driven.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s2.model.0: Past participles ihe atụ niile na-agwụ na -en; driven ziri ezi maka drive kwa.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s2.model.1: O nwere ụdị -en dịka eaten, taken, written; ya mere driven na-eso have.

l-e-m2-b05-11.title: Iwu comparative maka slowly na quickly
l-e-m2-b05-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke comparative nke adverbs na-ejedebe na -ly, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b05-11.material: slowly → more slowly, quickly → more quickly, carefully → more carefully. Chọta iwu site n'ikpe ndị ahụ ma kpebie comparative nke gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu comparative ziri ezi nke gently?
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.a: Gentle bụ adjective. Ikpe ndị ahụ na-edebe -ly dị ka o dị.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: Enweghị iwu nke ịgbakwunye -er n'ikpe ndị ahụ.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Na adverbs -ly, anyị anaghị agbakwunye -ier. Anyị na-etinye more n'ihu.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Adverbs na-ejedebe na -ly na-eme comparative site n'itinye more n'ihu. Gently na-aghọ more gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: N'ikpe ndị ahụ, a tinyere more n'ihu adverbs -ly, ya mere gently na-aghọkwa more gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Dịka na slowly na quickly, anyị na-edebe -ly ma jiri more, ya mere comparative nke gently bụ more gently.

l-e-m2-b05-12.title: Iwu It is ... for ... to
l-e-m2-b05-12.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu nke ụkpụrụ 'It is ... for (onye) to ...' site n'ọtụtụ ikpe, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b05-12.material: It is easy for me to swim. It is hard for kids to wait. It is important for us to sleep. Chọta iwu site n'ikpe ndị ahụ ma tinye ya n'ahịrịokwu dị n'okpuru.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.prompt: It is fun ___ them to play. Kedu okwu dabara?
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.r.a: N'ikpe ndị ahụ, for na-abịa tupu onye, ọ bụghị of.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.r.b: With anaghị apụta n'ikpe ndị ahụ.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: To bụ okwu na-abịa mgbe onye. Tupu onye anyị na-eji for.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.explain: Usoro bụ 'It is (adjective) for (onye) to (udi isi)'. Tinye for tupu onye.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: N'ikpe ndị ahụ, for bịara tupu onye mgbe adjective, ya mere ọ na-aghọ It is fun for them to play.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Onye na-abịa mgbe for, dịka n'easy for me na hard for kids, ya mere ọ bụ for them.

l-e-m2-b05-13.s.s1.prompt: The cake was eaten. → Kedu ahịrịokwu na-adịghị mma ziri ezi?

l-e-m2-b05-13.s.s1.r.c: Ị ghaghị idebe past participle eaten dị ka o dị.
l-e-m2-b05-13.s.s1.r.d: Passive negative na-etinye not mgbe be verb, ọ bụghị did not.
l-e-m2-b05-13.s.s1.explain: Tinye not mgbe be verb ma debe past participle dị ka o dị. Ọ na-aghọ The cake was not eaten.
l-e-m2-b05-13.s.s2.model.0: N'ikpe ndị ahụ, e tinyere not mgbe be verb past participle nọgidekwa otu, ya mere ọ na-aghọ The cake was not eaten.
l-e-m2-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Not na-abịa mgbe be verb, dịka n'was not locked na are not cleaned, ya mere ọ bụ was not eaten.

l-e-m2-b05-14.material: Has the bus left? — Yes, it has. / No, it hasn't. Have the kids arrived? — Yes, they have. Chọta iwu site n'ikpe ndị ahụ ma tinye ya n'ahịrịokwu dị n'okpuru.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.prompt: Has the train arrived? — No, ___. Kedu nke dabara?
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.a: Anyị na-aza ajụjụ present perfect site na has, ọ bụghị did.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.b: Na it, anyị na-eji has, ọ bụghị have.

l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s2.model.1: E nwere otu ụgbọ okporo ígwè ma ajụjụ ahụ na-amalite na has, ya mere ọ bụ it hasn't, na-eji hasn't.

l-e-m2-b07-03.title: Comparative nke adjectives na-akwụsị na -y
l-e-m2-b07-03.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke comparative na superlative nke adjectives na-akwụsị na -y, kwuo ya, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m2-b07-03.material: happy → happier → happiest. easy → easier → easiest. busy → busier → busiest. Chọta iwu site n'ihe atụ ndị ahụ ma tinye ya na funny.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ comparative na superlative ziri ezi nke funny?
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: Ị debere y ma gbakwunye naanị -er na -est.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: Ị jiri more/most kama iwu maka adjectives -y.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: Ị debere y, gbakwunye i, ma agwakọtakwa ọkpụkpụ.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na okwu na-akwụsị na consonant + y, gbanwee y ka ọ bụrụ i ma gbakwunye -er na -est.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: N'happy, easy, na busy, y na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ i ma a na-agbakwunye -er, ya mere funny na-abụkwa funnier na funniest.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: N'ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile, y na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ i ma ghọọ -ier na -iest, ya mere funny na-agbaso otu iwu ahụ.

l-e-m2-b02-18.s.s1.r.c: Otu peeji bụ ihe dị ka okwu 180, ya mere peeji 40 karịrị 700 nke ukwuu.

l-e-m2-b03-18.s.s1.r.d: Awa 4 ga-abụ peeji 80, nke dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-m2-b03-18.s.s1.explain: 24×3=nkeji 72. Ịgbakwunye nkeji 72 n'3:30 na-enye ihe dị ka 4:42.
l-e-m2-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Ịgụ peeji 24 n'nkeji 3 ọ bụla na-were nkeji 72, nke bụ awa 1 nkeji 12 mgbe 3:30, ya mere ihe dị ka 4:40.

l-e-m2-b06-16.s.s2.model.0: Ụgbọ okporo ígwè na-aga ihe dị ka 95km n'otu awa, na 95 − 55 = 40, ya mere ọ na-aga ihe dị ka 40km karịa.

l-e-m2-b01-21.title: Ebe ngwọta passive voice na-agabiga ụzọ
l-e-m2-b01-21.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ngwọta na-agbanwe ahịrịokwu active ka ọ bụrụ passive, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n'usoro, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ.
l-e-m2-b01-21.material: Gbanwee 'The cat chased the mouse.' ka ọ bụrụ passive: ① Buru ụzọ dee The mouse. ② Ọ bụ oge gara aga, ya mere jiri was. ③ Jiri udi mbụ chase maka verb. ④ Gbakwunye by the cat. → The mouse was chase by the cat.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: ① ziri ezi. Object na-aga n'ọnọdụ subject.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.o.b: Nzọụkwụ na-eji was n'ihi na ọ bụ oge gara aga (②)
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.r.b: ② ziri ezi. Passive oge gara aga na-eji was.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.o.c: Nzọụkwụ na-eji udi mbụ nke verb (③)
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.r.d: ④ ziri ezi. A na-ede onye mere ya site na by.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Passive chọrọ past participle. Jiri chased, ọ bụghị chase, ka ọ bụrụ was chased.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s2.model.0: N'③ e jiri udi mbụ chase, mana passive chọrọ past participle, ya mere dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ was chased.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s2.model.1: Ihe na-esote was ga-abụrịrị chased, ya mere ③ bụ njehie mbụ, ma The mouse was chased by the cat ziri ezi.

l-e-m2-b01-22.material: Ịgụ 'The teacher has gone to Busan.': ① gone to pụtara 'apụọla'. ② Onye nkụzi gara ma ọ bụbeghị mgbe ọ lọghachiri. ③ Ya mere onye nkụzi na-akụzi n'klas ugbu a. ④ Ya mere ọkụ klas ga-adị.

l-e-m2-b01-23.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ngwọta na-edegharị ahịrịokwu site na not as ~ as, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n'usoro, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ.
l-e-m2-b01-23.material: Ịgụ 'Hill A is higher than Hill B.': ① Hill B dị ala karịa Hill A. ② Anyị pụrụ ide B is not as high as A. ③ Ya mere anyị pụrụ ideekwa A is not as high as B. ④ A bụ ugwu dị elu karịa.

l-e-m2-b01-23.s.s1.r.b: ② ziri ezi. Nke dị ala bụ subject nke not as high as.
l-e-m2-b01-23.s.s1.r.d: ④ ziri ezi. Ị pụrụ ịmata ozugbo site n'ederede.
l-e-m2-b01-23.s.s1.explain: Subject nke not as high as bụ nke dị ala. A dị elu karịa, ya mere ③ dị n'azụ.

l-e-m2-b03-25.goal: Soro, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, ngwọta nke na-achịkọta mgbe a na-edebe usoro, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, iji chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru, ma rụzie ya.
l-e-m2-b03-25.material: Ederede: First, mix flour and eggs. Next, pour the mix into a pan. Last, bake it for ten minutes. Ngwọta: ① Nzọụkwụ mbụ bụ ịgwakọta. ② Nzọụkwụ nke abụọ bụ ịwụsa n'ite. ③ Nzọụkwụ nke atọ bụ ime achịcha. ④ Nchịkọta: 'Mix, bake, then pour.'

l-e-m2-b03-25.s.s1.r.b: ② ziri ezi. Nke na-esote bụ ịwụsa.
l-e-m2-b03-25.s.s1.r.c: ③ ziri ezi. Ikpeazụ bụ ime achịcha.
l-e-m2-b03-25.s.s1.explain: Nchịkọta ga-edebekwa usoro. 'Mix, pour, then bake' na-agbaso usoro ịgwakọta, ịwụsa, na ime achịcha.
l-e-m2-b03-25.s.s2.model.0: Nzọụkwụ ① ruo ③ na-edebe usoro dị ka ịgwakọta, ịwụsa, na ime achịcha, ya mere usoro bake na pour agbanwere n'④ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b03-25.s.s2.model.1: Nchịkọta ekwesịghị ịgbanwe usoro nke ederede, ya mere ọ gbagwojuru mbụ n'④ ma ga-arụzi ya ka ọ bụrụ Mix, pour, then bake.

l-e-m2-b04-22.title: Ebe ọrụ gabigara ụzọ na pronoun mgbe by
l-e-m2-b04-22.goal: Soro ọrụ maka ịgbanwe ahịrịokwu active voice ka ọ bụrụ ahịrịokwu passive voice, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-m2-b04-22.material: Gbanwee They built this house. ka ọ bụrụ passive voice. ① Tinye object this house n'ihu. ② Dee verb dị ka was built. ③ Debe They dị ka ọ dị mgbe by. Nsonaazụ: This house was built by they.
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s1.r.a: Ịkwaga object n'ọnọdụ subject ziri ezi.
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s1.o.b: ② Dere verb dị ka was built
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s1.r.b: Passive oge gara aga was built ziri ezi.
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s1.o.c: ③ Debere They dị ka ọ dị mgbe by
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s1.r.d: N'③, udi pronoun mgbe by ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s1.explain: Mgbe by, jiri them, ọ bụghị They. Ọ na-aghọ This house was built by them.
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe by, a chọrọ object pronoun, ya mere They ga-agbanwerịrị ka ọ bụrụ them, ma ③ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m2-b04-22.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe by, ị na-eji them, ọ bụghị they, ya mere njehie mbụ dị n'③.

l-e-m2-b04-23.title: Ebe ọrụ gabigara ụzọ n'ịgụ "Yes, I have"
l-e-m2-b04-23.goal: Soro ọrụ maka ịgụ azịza present perfect, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-m2-b04-23.material: Have you ever eaten sushi? — Yes, I have. A gụrụ azịza ahụ otu a. ① Ever na-ajụ banyere ahụmahụ ruo ugbu a. ② Yes, I have pụtara na onye ahụ riwo ya na mbụ. ③ Ya mere onye ahụ na-eri sushi kwa ụbọchị.
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ajụ ma ha emewo ya ruo ugbu a, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s1.o.b: ② Ọ pụtara na ha riwo ya na mbụ
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara na ha nwere ahụmahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s1.o.c: ③ Onye ahụ na-eri sushi kwa ụbọchị
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s1.r.d: ③ anaghị esochi nzọụkwụ ndị gara aga.
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s1.explain: Yes, I have pụtara na ha nwere ahụmahụ nke iri ya. Ọ naghị ekwu na ha na-eri ya kwa ụbọchị.
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s2.model.0: Site n'inwe ahụmahụ, ị nweghị ike ikwubi na ha na-eri ya kwa ụbọchị, ya mere ọ buru ụzọ gabigara ụzọ n'③.
l-e-m2-b04-23.s.s2.model.1: ③ na-agafe ihe ② pụtara site n'ikwu na ha na-eri ya kwa ụbọchị, ya mere nke ahụ bụ ebe ọ buru ụzọ gabigara ụzọ.

l-e-m2-b04-25.goal: Soro ọrụ na-elele ma a pụrụ iji gerund dị ka subject, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.

l-e-m2-b01-35.s.s2.model.1: A nwere naanị akụkọ gbasara nectar, ya mere nkwubi okwu nke ederede na-efu. B, nke gụnyekwara nkwubi okwu, bụ nchịkọta ka mma.

l-e-m2-b03-38.s.s2.model.0: Ịpụ na 7:40 site n'igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ pụtara iru nkeji 10 mgbe e mesịrị, na 7:50, ma ọ na-apụ n'oge ikpeazụ n'ime nhọrọ ndị kwere omume, ya mere ọ dabara nke kacha.

l-e-m2-b06-40.title: Ụzọ ịgụ ichọta isi echiche n'ime oke oge
l-e-m2-b06-40.goal: N'ụzọ na-echebe ma oge ma nghọta, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kwesịrị ekwesị kacha, ma kọwaa ihe mere.
l-e-m2-b06-40.material: Ị ga-aza isi echiche nke ederede okwu 1,000 n'ime nkeji 10. Ịgụ ederede niile nwayọọ na-ewe nkeji 12, ịgụ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ na nke ikpeazụ nke paragraf ọ bụla na-ewe nkeji 4, ma ịgụ naanị isiokwu na-ewe nkeji 1.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ụzọ ịgụ kwesịrị ekwesị kacha.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s1.r.a: Ị ga-amata isi echiche, ma ọ na-ewe nkeji 12, nke karịrị 10.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ewe nkeji 1, ma ozi ezughị ezu iji lelee isi echiche.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s1.r.c: Ị ga-enwe oge fọdụrụ, ma ị gaghị enwe ihe akaebe.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s1.o.d: Gụọ ahịrịokwu mbụ na nke ikpeazụ nke paragraf ọ bụla
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu mbụ na nke ikpeazụ na-ekwe ka ị lelee isi echiche n'ime nkeji 4, ya mere ọ na-echebe ma oge ma nghọta.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s2.model.0: Ịgụ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ na nke ikpeazụ na-ewe nkeji 4, ya mere ị na-agụcha n'ime nkeji 10 ma nwee ike ịmatakwa isi echiche, nke mere o ji kwesị.
l-e-m2-b06-40.s.s2.model.1: Ịgụ ihe niile na-agafe oge, ma ịgụ naanị isiokwu enweghị ihe akaebe, ya mere ụzọ ịgụ ahịrịokwu mbụ na nke ikpeazụ nke paragraf ọ bụla dị mma.

l-e-m2-b07-08.title: Ichọta ozi ịchọrọ n'ime nkeji 6
l-e-m2-b07-08.goal: N'ụzọ ịgụ iji chọta ozi ịchọrọ n'ime oke oge, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kwesịrị ekwesị kacha, ma kọwaa ihe mere.
l-e-m2-b07-08.material: Ị ga-agụ ọkwa nke paragraf 4 n'ime nkeji 6 ma zaa oge nzute (paragraf 1) na ihe a ga-ebute (paragraf 3). Ịgụ otu paragraf na-ewe nkeji 2, ma ịgụ ha niile na-ewe nkeji 8.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ na-edebe ma oke oge ma ozi ịchọrọ?
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.o.a: Gụọ paragraf 4 niile site na mmalite ruo njedebe
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ewe nkeji 8, nke karịrị nkeji 6.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.o.b: Gụọ naanị isiokwu ahụ ma chepụta azịza.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.r.b: Oge zuru ezu, ma ị gaghị achọta ozi ahụ.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ewe nkeji 2, ma ozi ị chọrọ adịghị na ya.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s1.explain: Ozi ị chọrọ dị na paragraf 1 na 3, ịgụ paragraf abụọ ahụ na-ewe nkeji 4, ya mere ị ga-emecha n'ime nkeji 6.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: Ozi ahụ dị na paragraf 1 na 3, ị nwere ike ịgụ ha n'ime nkeji 4, ya mere ị ka na-emezu ọnọdụ nkeji 6. Ịgụ ihe niile na-ewe nkeji 8, ya mere nke ahụ agaghị arụ ọrụ.
l-e-m2-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: Ị ga-achọta ma oge nzukọ ma ihe a ga-eweta n'ime nkeji 6, ya mere ịgụ naanị paragraf abụọ dị mkpa kacha dabara.
